{{Quote|There's only one way out of here. That's aboard her ship."<br>"Steal an Inquisitor's ship? How are we going to do that?"<br>"Carefully.|Clive Flax and Astri Oddo|<ref name="Reckoning" />}}
The [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]], [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]], used a '''cruiser''' when hunting down [[Clive Flax]] and [[Astri Oddo]]. Clive Flax and Astri Oddo used the cruiser to escape a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Reckoning" />

==History==
{{Quote|Okay. It was a genius plan."<br>"Better late than never.|Astri Oddo and Clive Flax|<ref name="Reckoning" />}}
Hydra used the cruiser to travel to a spaceport in search of Clive Flax and Astri Oddo. Clive schemed to steal Hydra's ship as it was their only way off the spaceport without being stopped by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]]. He plotted to be detained by Hydra, and then Astri, who would impersonate Hydra, would come and free him and they'd escape on Hydra's ship. Everything went according to plan, with Astri claiming she was taking Clive to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to an officer, requesting clearance. They successfully escaped the spaceport in Hydra's ship, leaving Hydra in the detainment cell.<ref name="Reckoning" />

==Layout==
{{Quote|You see? Even an Inquisitor needs a change of clothes. Put this on."<br>"You've got to be kidding."<br>"I don't kid when I'm looking at prison time, kiddo.|Clive Flax and Astri Oddo|<ref name="Reckoning" />}}
The cruiser had a cockpit with a viewport, alongside a small stateroom that had a small recessed door that held a spare robe for Hydra.<ref name="Reckoning" />
